projects.title: Jumpgate · Zero-Trust Agentic AI Landing Zone & Vending Machine
projects.summary: Self-service Dual-VPC cloud landing zone and 14-step Vending Machine Agent that compresses 4 to 6 weeks of setup and IM8 security verification into under 3 minutes, driving $1.96M in realised public sector ARR (+$1.46M pipeline).
projects.architecture: Separates Ingress (Regional HTTPS ALB with TLS 1.3, Cloud Armor OWASP WAF, Serverless NEG, IAM-locked Cloud Run) from Egress (Secure Web Proxy Layer 7 domain allowlisting, Private Service Connect to Vertex AI, non-root SHA-256 pinned containers) in Terraform. Paired with a 4-agent, 14-step ADLC pipeline enforcing an >=0.85 LLM-as-a-Judge quality gate and passing 14/14 Ingress runtime and 18/18 Egress static security checks.

projects.title: Jetski Agent Tracer Plugin
projects.summary: Real-time execution graph and three-lane architecture visualiser for autonomous agents, streaming live JSONL transcripts into Timeline, Architecture, and Simplified views.
projects.architecture: Zero-dependency Python 3 HTTP backend with 1.5s delta-tail JSONL streaming, paired with a Vis.js and SVG topology frontend. Detects mid-text tool exit codes, strips metadata envelopes, and supports inline subagent trajectory drill-down.

projects.title: Jetski Harness
projects.summary: Unified multi-agent workspace UI plugin combining a customisable 2x2 Bento grid, multi-session agent chat, embedded Agent Tracer graph, automation controls, and live token telemetry.
projects.architecture: Streams per-turn prompt, cached-context, and output token metrics from the local Language Server, calculates context window saturation against the 200k compaction threshold, and dispatches multi-session prompts.

projects.title: Smart Meeting Prep and Dossier Agent
projects.summary: Two-stage scheduled agent that researches external and cross-functional meetings across Calendar, Gmail, Chat, Drive, and People Directory to generate cited one-page briefing docs.
projects.architecture: Pairs a Next-Business-Day dossier generator with a stateless T-1h reminder partitioned into 60-minute windows. Verified by a 5-scenario, 36-check mock test harness with an automated linter that flags hallucinated names, bugs, and URLs.

projects.title: EduVerse
projects.summary: Awarded 2nd Place Overall at NUS, Singtel, and Millennium Management LifeHack 2025. Adaptive learning platform pairing modular classroom routing with an ~85% accuracy Knowledge Tracing model.
projects.architecture: Modular React, Next.js, and TypeScript platform deployed on Cloudflare Workers for low-latency serverless execution, integrated with a Python and PyTorch Knowledge Tracing (kt_models) recommendation engine.

projects.title: MINDSync (Lobang-Octagon)
projects.summary: Built for Hack4Good. Centralised multi-branch event and volunteer management platform for MINDS, replacing scattered spreadsheets and forms across branches.
projects.architecture: Role-based web application in TypeScript, Next.js App Router, and Supabase supporting staff, caregivers, and volunteers with unified calendar views, PostgreSQL RPC signup workflows, and real-time event coverage tracking.

projects.title: Multi-Cloud Serverless Application
projects.summary: Full-stack serverless web application demonstrating cloud-portable CRUD workflows, real-time state synchronisation across browser tabs, and automated CI/CD.
projects.architecture: React and Vite frontend deployed on Vercel backed by Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Realtime) and AWS serverless primitives provisioned with Terraform Infrastructure-as-Code and GitHub Actions.

projects.title: Uncertainty Quantification & XAI for Battery Analytics
projects.summary: First-author paper at APSIPA ASC 2025 (IEEE Xplore) from A*STAR research. Unified deep learning framework quantifying both model and data uncertainty for battery State-of-Health estimation.
projects.architecture: Integrates Adaptive Conformal Inference (ACI), Prediction Interval Coverage Probability (PICP), Expected Calibration Error (ECE), and model-agnostic SHAP/LIME attributions into a CNN pipeline evaluated across McMaster and Oxford datasets.

projects.title: Real-Time Semantic Segmentation & Multimodal Captioning
projects.summary: Real-time computer vision inspection pipeline combining live frame-by-frame DeepLabV3+ResNet50 semantic segmentation with context-aware natural language captions.
projects.architecture: Streams webcam video through a PyTorch DeepLabV3+ResNet50 backbone to overlay semantic pixel masks via OpenCV and NumPy, paired with the Hugging Face BLIP vision-language model for live scene captioning.

projects.title: TransportGPT
projects.summary: Built for the NUS NCS Innovation Challenge 2024. Multimodal traffic intelligence system combining live camera feeds, vehicle detection, and LLM synthesis.
projects.architecture: Chains YOLOv3 computer vision detection on traffic camera streams with time-series congestion modelling and LangChain LLM prompts to produce plain-English routing advisories.

projects.title: Panasonic Commercial HVAC Control Dashboard
projects.summary: Industry collaboration case study building a centralised web dashboard to monitor and control commercial HVAC units across building zones.
projects.architecture: Combines a Svelte frontend and Three.js interactive 3D floor-plan visualiser with a Node.js and WebSocket backend streaming live telemetry and energy consumption metrics.

projects.title: Autonomous Air Defence System (DSTA BrainHack 2024)
projects.summary: Semifinalist at DSTA BrainHack 2024 (TIL-AI). Voice-commanded multimodal defence pipeline linking spoken mission orders to live aircraft bounding box detection.
projects.architecture: Containerised pipeline integrating OpenAI Whisper real-time speech transcription, a custom-trained text-to-JSON NLP parser (>85% parsing accuracy), and Vision-Language Modelling (~80% aircraft bounding box alignment accuracy).

projects.title: OnlyNotes Note Sharing Application
projects.summary: Collaborative Android note-sharing, flashcard, and study-group application built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Firebase, and MVVM architecture.
projects.architecture: Native Android client architected with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose declarative UI, and MVVM state management, backed by Firebase Authentication, Cloud Firestore real-time document sync, and Cloud Storage.

projects.title: LobangCube Financial Wellness Platform
projects.summary: Interactive personal finance and budgeting analytics application built with Python and Streamlit to visualise cashflow, savings goals, and spending categories.
projects.architecture: Data-driven Python and Streamlit web application that ingests personal transaction ledgers, computes category-level budget variance and savings projections, and renders interactive financial health dashboards.
